inputs.name: GptImageAdapter.constructor.send
inputs.description: Function that sends the HTTP request as send(url, options) and resolves to a Response; the adapter reads that Response's ok and status properties and calls its text() method. Defaults to globalThis.fetch when the argument is undefined.

inputs.name: GptImageAdapter.generate.key
inputs.description: OpenAI API key sent as the Bearer credential in the Authorization header of the POST to https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations; the adapter appends it unchanged to 'Bearer ' and does not check its format.

inputs.name: GptImageAdapter.generate.prompt
inputs.description: Text prompt sent unchanged as the prompt field of the JSON request body for model gpt-image-2; the adapter does not trim, validate or length-limit it.
examples: A stone pyramid bathed in moonlight on a dark desert plateau, painterly game-art style
Isometric lunar temple with glowing blue runes on a night-time mesa, clean outlines, plain dark background

outputs.name: GptImageAdapter.generate
outputs.description: Resolves to a Buffer with the decoded PNG bytes of the first image, taken from data[0].b64_json in the provider response; the request asks for one 1536x1024 medium-quality PNG. The resolved buffer is at most 12,000,000 bytes and begins with the 8-byte PNG signature, and the promise rejects instead when a check fails.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as a plain Error with these messages: 'Image generation failed. Check this project’s OpenAI configuration. No retry was made.' when the request is rejected (network failure, the 180-second timeout, or a redirect, since the request sets redirect: 'error'); 'Image generation failed (HTTP <status>). No retry was made.' when the HTTP status is not OK; 'Generated image exceeds the size limit.' when the response text is longer than 24,000,000 characters; 'Provider did not return a PNG image.' when the body is not JSON or data[0].b64_json is missing, empty or not base64; and 'Provider did not return a valid PNG image.' when the decoded image is over 12,000,000 bytes or lacks the PNG signature. Errors from reading the response body are not caught and propagate unchanged.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by unguarded reads and Buffer.from in the adapter: when send resolves to null or undefined (response.ok is read), when the parsed body is the JSON literal null (result.data is read), or when data[0].b64_json is a non-zero JSON number or true whose string form passes the base64 pattern test (Buffer.from then rejects it).
